images.alt: Collage of four photos showing learning, community, and healthcare settings. Top left shows several people seated around a table indoors, working with anatomy models and printed diagrams. Top right shows two people standing indoors holding certificates, with educational posters about Māori birthing practices and midwifery displayed behind them. Bottom left shows a small group wearing healthcare uniforms gathered indoors around a chair, with stethoscopes visible. Bottom right shows three people standing outdoors near trees, posing together for a photo. Along the bottom of the graphic are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government logo and the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logo.

Two‑panel collage showing group gatherings and learning sessions. The top image shows a large group standing outdoors in front of a wharenui with carved decorations, arranged together for a group photo. The bottom image shows a large group seated and standing indoors around desks in a classroom or workshop setting, with notebooks and materials visible. Along the bottom of the graphic are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government logo and the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logo.

Collage of four photos showing people working, learning, and collaborating in healthcare and education settings. Top left shows a small group indoors providing hands‑on care to an infant during a supervised clinical learning activity. Top right shows a group seated and standing indoors, gathered together for a group photo in a healthcare room. Bottom left shows a group standing outdoors in front of a carved building entrance, arranged in a line for a group photo. Bottom right shows a small group indoors gathered around a computer screen, looking at displayed information together. Along the bottom of the graphic are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government logo and the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logo.

Collage of four photos showing learning and group activities in health education settings. Top left shows several people seated at tables indoors, working with anatomical models and writing notes during a learning session. Top right shows a group gathered indoors for a group photo against a plain wall. Bottom left shows a smaller group standing together indoors, posing for a group photo. Bottom right shows close‑up anatomical teaching models of reproductive organs placed on a table during a class. Along the bottom of the graphic are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government logo and the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logo

post.text:
On #InternationalDayoftheMidwife we recognise midwifery students across NZ and their role in the future of our maternity system. Through clinical leadership, the Ministry works with schools and sector partners to build insight into workforce sustainability.

#MoH #InternationalDayofMidwives
